sentences.sentence_text: Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to industrialize governed agentic AI, aligning control-plane architecture, lifecycle discipline, and a commercial operating model so regulated enterprise clients could adopt reusable platform services rather than receive isolated bespoke solutions.
